npm.reason: The published advisory affects React Router RSC action handling. Serious Shift is a client-only BrowserRouter SPA exported as static files and defines no RSC routes or server actions. The advisory's stated patched 8.3.0 release is not published; downgrading would reintroduce other fixed React Router advisories.

rust.reason: The medium-severity Marvin Attack advisory has no fixed release. rsa 0.9.10 is retained only in Cargo.lock through an inactive optional dependency: cargo tree -i rsa reports no active path for this backend. Serious Shift performs no RSA operations and terminates TLS outside the application on Railway.
